text_block_list.text:
Today, a party was being held as part of
the academy's public relations activities.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otome
text_block_list.text:
Look at that! Rudolf-san, Maruzen-san,
and even C.B.-san... What a dreamlike party this is!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otome
text_block_list.text:
We'll even have an exhibition race between the three of them afterwards!
My notepad and my racing heart just can't keep up!

Indeed, I couldn't afford to miss the exhibition race
coming up next, if only to incorporate what I learned into future training...
Or so I was thinking, right at that moment.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, such a nice night breeze.
...I feel like going for a walk.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm? Just taking a breather.
choice_data_list: Huh?! But what about the race—?!

text_block_list.text:
Before I can stop her, Mr. C.B. starts wandering off.
But it's bad news if the guest of honor disappears from the party!
I've got to bring her back—!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hum-dee-dum...
Oh, looks like that person is solo camping.
Wood stoves really are the best, huh—
choice_data_list: C.B., let's get back to the party!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're from before...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mm, sorry!
My body just isn't ready to go back yet!

With that, Mr. C.B. effortlessly vaulted over a bench,
slid down a handrail...
and vanished with movements straight out of parkour.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Boss, is it really that weird?
Biting in from the back is pretty tasty too—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good work catching up.
You're working up quite a nice sweat!
(*Grumble...*)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, sounds like your tummy is in top form too.
Yep, healthy, healthy!

A piping-hot taiyaki was promptly shoved into my open mouth!
A savory yet sweet aroma instantly filled the air...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's for you! Seeing you all sweaty like that
made me want to go for a run too!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Phew, the cool night breeze feels so good!

Mr. C.B. runs ahead in high spirits.
Being dragged along by her whims has pushed my stamina to its limit.

I don't normally sprint around with such desperation,
and the clothes I picked out for the party are now sticking to me with sweat.
...And yet—

As I chased after her light-footed stride and unpredictable antics with all my might,
a smile naturally crept across my face...

Being tossed around by such a lively, free spirit wasn't so bad after all...
Or so I thought, until—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a LANE message from Rudolf.
...Looks like it's almost time for the exhibition race, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mm, my body's all warmed up now... time to head over.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: So, we're heading back now, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Here, take this. For your "breather break."
I bought it just a bit ago, and I'm pretty sure I haven't taken a sip yet.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I mean, your legs are wobbling like jelly.
You should rest up before you try moving again.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
See ya!
Feel free to come watch the race if you'd like!

She really is too free-spirited to keep up with...!
As she skipped away with a light spring in her step,
I staggered along behind on shaky legs...
